style: Avant-garde chamber-folk art-rock with breathlessly urgent hype delivery and deep bewilderment headspace. Harmony: polyharmonic quartal suspension fields with microtonal pure interval friction and shifting modal drone centers. Melody: clipped phonetic consonant runs with obsessional pharyngeal emphatics, alveolar trills, front-rounded vowels, and phrase-level prominence peaks. Rhythm: 3:2 cross-rhythm coupling, asymmetric meter collisions, and double-time vocal/percussive hallucinations. Timbre: wavetable synthesis, subtractive resonance, tagelharpa bowed lyre, doumbe darbuka, qanun, udu drum, djembe, balafon, and processed modular feedback loops. Performance: hysterical, highly articulate urgency paired with chronic working-memory confusion, neurological slipstream pacing, and acute perceptual drift. Anchor: a recurrent vocal distress call about time and vanishing objects that returns more fractured after every structural drop, bleeding further into recursive epistemic vertigo.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Opening pulse from dry udu and sharp djembe snaps in 3:2 metric friction]
[Breathless announcer voice, pacing rapidly]
Look! Look right here! We are running out of seconds before the next category vanishes!
[Tagelharpa drone enters with raw wooden bow friction]
Why do I lose everything all the time?
[Lead vocal snaps in with obsessive pharyngeal emphatics and alveolar trills]
Where did the minutes go? Where did the keys roll?
Every pocket is a sieve, every drawer is an empty hole!
[Qanun plucks rapid ornamental bursts across the stereo field]
We checked the floor! We checked the ceiling!
And yet the absence is accumulating, ceiling after ceiling!
[A secondary pulse of modular clicks begins tracing the perimeter of the soundstage]
We left the coat on the hook, now the hook is bare iron and the coat is a myth!
We held the blueprint under our tongue, now our teeth are biting into absolute zero width!
[An old receipt curls up into ash inside our palm before the transaction can be verified]
We trace the contours of yesterday's breakfast only to find an empty geometric grid of despair!

[Chorus]
[Choral counterpoint lattice enters with independent staggered entries]
Why do I lose everything all the time?
[Soprano voice]
It slipped through the lattice!
[Tenor voice]
It dissolved in the statute!
[All voices together with front-rounded vowel shifts]
We had it in hand for a fraction of a pulse,
Now it's gone into the salt and the dust!
[Darbuka bass hits anchor a sudden double-time syllable run]
Faster! Faster before the nouns evaporate!
[The background harmonic drones fracture into microtonal shards]
We are misplacing the momentum of our own footsteps while we walk!
[Every landmark dissolves into a shifting mirage of unverified coordinates]

[Verse 2]
[Jurisdiction dropout: harmony vanishes, leaving only unpitched udu taps and vocal hockets]
[Bewildered monologue, voice cracking with frantic urgency]
Wait. Stop. Let us re-examine the inventory.
If the object was here at index zero, why is index zero missing?
[Subtractive synth filter cutoff sweeps upward like a rising question mark]
Is time a thief or is my memory a sieve with too much voltage?
[Balafon wooden keys enter with dry buzzing membrane resonance]
Every answer spawns three new interrogations!
We are losing the definitions while we speak!
Why do I lose everything all the time?
[Wavetable synth morphs timbrally on a sustained static pitch]
The table is bare! The cupboard is stripped to the grain!
[We trace the phantom outlines of utensils that evaporated before they could be touched]
Even the shadows are sliding off the walls like melted wax!
[The very concept of permanence is bleeding out through the cracks in the subfloor]
We search for the anchor but the anchor itself has decoupled from its own gravity!
Every single boundary line has frayed into an indistinct smear of statistical noise across the dashboard of the brain!

[Bridge]
[Meter collision: 3+3 rhythm in the strings against 2+2+2 in the percussion]
[Choral cast shouts in frantic polyphony]
Check the margin! Check the residue!
[Soprano]
It left a shadow!
[Alto]
It left a frequency!
[Tenor]
It left an echo of a ghost of a memory!
[Hysterical escalation, breathless delivery speed doubling]
We are not just losing objects, we are losing the verb of having!
Nothing stays put! Nothing remains stationary!
Why do I lose everything all the time?
[Abrupt drop to dead silence for two beats]
[A solitary ticking clock emerges from the void, but every fifth tick occurs backwards in spatial audio]
We are hemorrhaging luggage through the fabric of the immediate present!
[The walls of the room are shrinking inward as the spatial dimensions trade places with abstract numbers]
We try to grasp the air itself, but our fingers pass through without meeting any atmospheric resistance!

[Chorus]
[Full ensemble re-engages with luminous friction orchestra bowed metal and qanun tremolo]
Why do I lose everything all the time?
[Choral counterpoint lattice at maximum kinetic density]
It slipped through the lattice!
It dissolved in the statute!
We had it in hand for a fraction of a pulse,
Now it's gone into the salt and the dust!
[Rapid alveolar trills on every eligible rhotic]
Trance-state terror! Phenomenological panic!
Every horizon recedes faster than our vocal cords can track its coordinates!
[The collective consciousness fragments into a thousand uncoordinated observation posts]

[Outro]
[Subtractive filter closing down rapidly]
[Wavetable position freezing on a raw harmonic spectrum]
[Whispered frantic query, breath fading into cassette tape hiss]
Did we ever even possess it to begin with...
Or was it just a rumor told by the clock?
[Tagelharpa bowed drone sustains into an unresolved overtone suspension]
Why do I lose everything all the time?
[Final dry udu tap, a distant metallic rattle of an unlatched door, and absolute silence]
caption: An avant-garde chamber art-rock track driven by breathless hype delivery, deep bewilderment, and complex metric friction. Features a hybrid acoustic palette of tagelharpa, qanun, udu, darbuka, and wavetable synths, paired with obsessive pharyngeal phonetics, choral counterpoint lattices, and a relentless 3:2 cross-rhythm. The sovereign seed of vanishing time and lost objects is structurally unpacked through frantic polyphonic interrogation and sudden instrumental dropouts into epistemic vertigo
